description: Renovate config for talos-nvidia-open-extension. Driver bumps track GitHub releases of NVIDIA/open-gpu-kernel-modules directly (we build modules from the source tarball and pull GSP firmware from the matching .run installer, so the redist-channel lag does not apply). The github-releases datasource skips prereleases by default, which excludes the 595.44.x Vulkan-beta releases. After a driver or toolkit bump merges, run hack/update-checksums.sh to recompute all eight checksums in vars.yaml (NVIDIA publishes none for these artifacts). After a CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION bump, update CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_REF by hand to the tag's commit (`gh api repos/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit/git/ref/tags/<ver> --jq .object.sha`, dereference annotated tags).

customManagers.description: NVIDIA driver pin in vars.yaml, annotated with '# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=NVIDIA/open-gpu-kernel-modules' above NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION. Same matchString shape as siderolabs/pkgs uses for its Pkgfile.

wolfi-base digest pin (WOLFI_BASE_REF) in vars.yaml, used by the glibc-linked toolkit build stages. Tracked as the latest digest of cgr.dev/chainguard/wolfi-base; currentValueTemplate is scoped to this manager only so it does not override the driver/toolkit version captures in the manager above.

TALOS_VERSION pin in the Makefile, tracked against siderolabs/talos releases. PKGS and TOOLS are intentionally NOT automated: PKGS must equal the pkgs tag pinned by the target Talos release (see 'make talos-pkgs-version') and TOOLS must match TOOLS_REV in that pkgs tag's Pkgfile — no datasource models that coupling, so bump all three together by hand when moving to a new Talos release.

packageRules.description: NVIDIA driver versions are not semver (e.g. 610.43.02 or 595.84); use the same regex versioning siderolabs/pkgs applies to its nvidia driver packages.
Container toolkit bumps are independent of driver bumps; group them so a toolkit PR never touches NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION.
wolfi-base digest pin used by the glibc-linked build stages.
